""" def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page by safely inserting the visitor's content into a predefined template. Parameters ---------- visitor_content : str User supplied content that will be embedded into the page. Returns ------- str The final HTML string with the user's content safely escaped. """ # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection (CWE-74). safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Format the template with the escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
